signIn.title: Sign in to ZCode
signIn.body: Sign in the way the ZCode app does: Z.ai or BigModel opens in your browser and this finishes by itself. A GLM Coding Plan key, a seat on a team's plan or ZCode's free Start Plan is taken from the account.
